printed_equations.formula: qult = c (Nc) + q (Nq) + 0.5 (γ)(Bf)(Nγ)  [“Cohesion” term + “Surcharge” term + Foundation soil “Weight” term]

variables.qult: gross ultimate bearing capacity of a concentrically loaded rigid strip footing with a rough base on a level homogeneous foundation material without water (after Terzaghi, 1943)
variables.q: total surcharge at the base of the footing = qappl + γa Df (ksf) (kPa); qappl = applied surcharge (ksf) (kPa); γa = unit weight of the overburden material above the base of the footing causing the surcharge pressure (kcf) (kN/m3)
variables.γ: unit weight of the soil under the footing (kcf) (kN/m3)
variables.Bf: footing width, i.e., least lateral dimension of the footing (ft) (m) (Figure 8-1)

variables.Nq: bearing capacity factor for the “surcharge” term (dimensionless)

variables.Nc: bearing capacity factor for the “cohesion” term (dimensionless)
bearing capacity factor for the “cohesion” term (dimensionless)

variables.Nγ: bearing capacity factor for the “weight” term (dimensionless)

printed_equations.formula: Si = C1 C2 Δp Σ(i=1 to n) ΔHi   where   ΔHi = Hc (Iz / XE)

variables.Si: immediate settlement of a spread footing (Schmertmann et al., 1978)
variables.C1: correction factor for strain relief due to embedment, Equation 8-17
variables.C2: correction factor for time-dependent (creep) increase in settlement, Equation 8-18
variables.Δp: net uniform applied stress (load intensity) at the foundation depth (Figure 8-21b)
variables.n: number of soil layers within the zone of strain influence (strain influence diagram)
variables.Hc: thickness of layer i (the symbol is not defined on p. 8-45)
variables.Iz: strain influence factor from Figure 8-21a (Bf is the least lateral effective footing dimension)
variables.X: factor used to determine the value of elastic modulus: with E from N160 or qc correlations of Table 5-16, X = 1.25 for the axisymmetric case (Lf/Bf = 1) and 1.75 for the plane strain case (Lf/Bf ≥ 10), interpolated for 1 < Lf/Bf ≤ 10; X = 1.0 if E is estimated from the range of elastic moduli in Table 5-16 or other sources
variables.E: elastic modulus of layer i (Table 5-16 in Chapter 5)

variables.C1: correction factor to incorporate the effect of strain relief due to embedment
variables.po: effective in-situ overburden stress at the foundation depth

variables.C2: correction factor to incorporate time-dependent (creep) increase in settlement
variables.t: time after construction (years); 0.1 years gives the settlement immediately after construction (C2 = 1)

printed_equations.formula: δv = Cd Δp Bf (1 – ν²) / Em

variables.Δp: change in stress at top of rock surface due to applied footing load
variables.Em: Young’s modulus of rock mass (Section 5.12.1 in Chapter 5)

variables.N': average corrected SPT N160 value within a depth B below pile toe (printed with an overbar)

printed_equations.formula: Qt = qt At = Nc sut At

variables.Qt: ultimate tip resistance of a drilled shaft in cohesive soil under undrained loading
variables.qt: unit tip resistance; its limiting value (qt = Nc sut) is 80 ksf
variables.sut: undrained shear strength of the soil at the tip of the shaft, from tests within 2.0 diameters below the tip

variables.Nc: bearing capacity factor; multiplied by 0.67 if the soil within 2.0 diameters of the tip has sut < 0.5 ksf
variables.z: depth of the penetration of the shaft
variables.D: diameter of the shaft (units of z and D consistent)

printed_equations.formula: Qs = πD Σ(i=1 to N) βi po Δzi

variables.Qs: ultimate side resistance of a cylindrical shaft in cohesionless soil (or effective stress analysis in cohesive soil under drained loading)
variables.N: number of layers used in the analysis
variables.po: effective overburden pressure at the center of the ith layer

variables.βi: side resistance coefficient of the ith layer
variables.zi: the depth in feet to the center of the ith layer

variables.fsi: ultimate unit load transfer in side resistance at any depth; its limiting value for shafts in cohesionless soils is 4 ksf (191 kPa)
variables.po: effective overburden pressure at the center of the ith layer

variables.Qt: ultimate tip resistance of a drilled shaft in cohesionless soil (or effective stress analysis in cohesive soil)

variables.N60: SPT blow count within a depth of 2B below the tip of the shaft
SPT blow count within a depth of 2B below the tip of the shaft

variables.Qsr: ultimate side resistance of a shaft socketed into rock (Horvath and Kenney, 1979); for a smooth socket or rock drilled with slurry, and for intact rock only
variables.qsr: unit skin resistance of rock (tsf), Equation 9-47

variables.αE: EM/Ei = reduction factor to account for jointing in rock (Table 5-23 in Chapter 5); EM elastic modulus of the rock mass, Ei elastic modulus of intact rock (p. 9-141)

variables.Ω: dimensionless coefficient, which for most soils can be taken as sin φ′ (Mayne and Kulhawy, 1982)

printed_equations.formula: Ka = (1 – sin φ′) / (1 + sin φ′) = tan²(45 – φ′/2)

variables.Ka: active earth pressure coefficient for a vertical wall, level ground, no wall friction and no groundwater (Coulomb with δ = θ = β = 0; Rankine)

printed_equations.formula: Kp = (1 + sin φ′) / (1 – sin φ′) = tan²(45 + φ′/2)

variables.Kp: passive earth pressure coefficient for a vertical wall, level ground, no wall friction and no groundwater (Coulomb with δ = θ = β = 0; Rankine)
